span.p:
measure uptime: GetProcessTimes vs
GetSystemTimeAsFileTime; divide by
600,000,000 (100 ns units)
= elapsed minutes

span.p:
XOR the whole buffer with
WM_CREATE ^ WM_NCCALCSIZE = 0x82,
then 15 fixed constants
over bytes 0..14

span.p:
drop resource 101 to %TEMP%\Partner_CTF.exe
and launch it; CreateNamedPipe
\\.\pipe\FlareChallenge; write
strlen(buffer) bytes — which
truncates it to 'HarryPotter'
